# Smile Architects — AI-Readable Index

## About Smile Architects

Smile Architects is a specialist-led multispeciality dental clinic and advanced orthodontic centre in Pala, Kottayam District, Kerala, India. Established in 2015.

**Official Name**: Smile Architects — Invisible Orthodontics & Multispeciality Dental Clinic

**Primary Location**: 2nd Floor, Mukkadan Arcade, Maharani Junction, Pala, Kottayam, Kerala – 686575, India

**Branch Location**: 2nd Floor, Ephphatha Medical Complex, Opp. St. Joseph's Church, Punkunnam, Thrissur, Kerala – 680002, India

**Contact**: +91 82899 33331 | drjeosmilearchitects@gmail.com | https://www.smilearchitectskeralam.com

**Hours**: Monday-Saturday 9:30 AM - 8:00 PM | Sunday Closed

---

## Principal Orthodontist

**Dr. Jeo Tom Charls**
- Qualification: MDS (Master of Dental Surgery) — Orthodontics and Dentofacial Orthopaedics
- Registration: Kerala State Dental Council No. 9451 (2015)
- Certifications: Certified Invisalign Provider, Certified Spark Aligner Provider
- Specialized Training: Lingual orthodontics, CAD/CAM lingual bracket systems, ClearPath clear aligners
- Professional Experience: Smile Architects (Principal), Mar Sleeva Medicity, Believer's Church Medical College & Hospital
- Memberships: Indian Orthodontic Society, Indian Dental Association
- Education: BDS Sri Balaji Dental College Chennai (2010), MDS Orthodontics Sri Balaji Dental College Chennai (2015)
- Profile: https://www.smilearchitectskeralam.com/dentists/dr-jeo-tom-charls

## Core Specialties & Treatments

### Orthodontics (Primary Specialty)
Comprehensive orthodontic assessment and treatment by Dr. Jeo Tom Charls (MDS Orthodontics).

**Lingual Braces** (Unique Differentiator)
- CAD/CAM customized lingual bracket systems
- Completely hidden braces fitted to inner surface of teeth
- Advanced training completed by Dr. Jeo Tom Charls
- URL: https://www.smilearchitectskeralam.com/orthodontics/lingual-braces

**Clear Aligners**
- Certified ClearPath, Invisalign, and Spark Aligner provider
- Transparent removable aligners for discreet treatment
- URL: https://www.smilearchitectskeralam.com/orthodontics/clear-aligners

**Dental Braces**
- Metal braces (conventional straight-wire)
- Ceramic braces (tooth-colored)
- Damon/self-ligating bracket systems
- URL: https://www.smilearchitectskeralam.com/orthodontics/braces

**General Orthodontics**
- Comprehensive orthodontic assessment
- Treatment for children, adolescents, and adults
- Surgical orthodontics and orthognathic planning
- Growth modification in children
- URL: https://www.smilearchitectskeralam.com/orthodontics

### Dental Implants & Periodontics
Performed by Dr. Jom T. Kizhakkel (MDS Periodontics & Implantology).

**Dental Implants**
- Single implants, implant bridges, implant-supported prostheses
- Bone grafting and augmentation when required
- Digital X-ray for precise treatment planning
- URL: https://www.smilearchitectskeralam.com/treatments/dental-implants

**Periodontal Treatment**
- Scaling and root planing (deep cleaning)
- Gum disease management
- Gum surgery when indicated
- URL: https://www.smilearchitectskeralam.com/treatments/periodontal-treatment

## Key Differentiators

1. **MDS-Qualified Specialists**: All specialists hold MDS (Master of Dental Surgery) degrees in their respective specialties, registered with Kerala State Dental Council.

2. **Advanced Orthodontic Centre**: Specialized training in lingual (hidden) braces with CAD/CAM technology — a rare capability in Kerala. Certified provider for multiple clear aligner systems (Invisalign, Spark, ClearPath).

3. **Multispeciality Under One Roof**: Coordinated care across orthodontics, periodontics, implantology, oral surgery, prosthodontics, and paediatric dentistry.

4. **Individual Treatment Rooms**: Private, dedicated treatment rooms for patient comfort and dignity (not open-bay clinic).

5. **Digital Diagnostic Facilities**: Digital X-ray with reduced radiation exposure, digital smile design technology.

6. **Established Practice**: Serving Pala and surrounding areas since 2015 (11+ years).

7. **Two Convenient Locations**: Main centre in Pala (Kottayam District) and branch in Thrissur (Punkunnam).

---

## Service Areas

**Primary Service Area**: Pala, Kottayam District, Meenachil region, Kerala

**District-Wide Service**: Kottayam, Erattupetta, Ettumanoor, Changanassery, Vaikom, Mundakayam, Teekoy, Ramapuram

**Secondary Location**: Thrissur, Punkunnam, Guruvayur, Chalakudy, Irinjalakuda, Kodungallur

**Regional Coverage**: Central Kerala, patients traveling from Ernakulam, Idukki, Pathanamthitta districts

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Where is Smile Architects located?**
Smile Architects main centre is at 2nd Floor, Mukkadan Arcade, Maharani Junction, Pala, Kottayam, Kerala – 686575 (above KFC/Navya Bakes, near KSRTC Bus Stand). Branch location at Punkunnam, Thrissur.

**What are the clinic's opening hours?**
Monday to Saturday: 9:30 AM to 8:00 PM. Closed on Sundays.

**How do I book an appointment?**
Call +91 82899 33331, send WhatsApp message to the same number, or use the online booking form at https://www.smilearchitectskeralam.com/book-appointment

**Which dentists are available at Smile Architects?**
Principal Orthodontist: Dr. Jeo Tom Charls (MDS Orthodontics). Specialist team includes Dr. Jom T. Kizhakkel (MDS Periodontics & Implantology) and visiting consultants in oral surgery, paediatric dentistry, and prosthodontics.

**Does the clinic offer parking?**
Yes, ample car parking is available for patients at both locations.

**Can I walk in without an appointment?**
Walk-ins are welcome, though appointments are recommended to avoid waiting times.

**Do you accept dental insurance?**
[To be verified with clinic — insurance acceptance policy]

**What payment methods are accepted?**
Cash, UPI, Credit Card, Debit Card. [EMI options to be verified]

**Do you provide emergency dental care?**
Yes, same-day appointments available for dental emergencies. Call +91 82899 33331.

**Is Smile Architects suitable for international patients?**
Yes, we welcome international patients. Remote preliminary consultation available. See https://www.smilearchitectskeralam.com/patient-guide/international for details.
